title: org.ligatureprotocol.revocation
description: DRAFT. The payload of a revocation or key abandonment (spec chapters 02 and 07), carried in an envelope signed by an introducer's self-signing key. The domain ligatureprotocol.org is a placeholder; it is not yet registered.

publicKey.description: A public key as a multibase string with a multicodec prefix (an Ed25519 key renders as z6Mk…).

subject.description: The key no longer trusted: a binding, a principal, a known person, or an abandoned master key.

person.description: The master key on whose behalf the revocation is made.
